demo.program:
# F# — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created F#?", "Microsoft (Don Syme)"),
    ("What paradigm is F#?", "functional + OOP"),
    ("What is creator?", "Microsoft (Don Syme)"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "2005"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "functional + OOP"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".fs"),
    ("What is hello world?", "printfn \"Hello, world!\""),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
